newsitem.title: USA: US stocks keep lofty heights post-FOMC, Dow up 100.
newsitem.headline: US stocks keep lofty heights post-FOMC, Dow up 100.

text.p: U.S. stocks maintained their lofty heights after the U.S. central bank's Federal Open Market Committee announced no change in monetary policy.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose to be up over 100 points just seconds before the announcement at 1415 EDT/1915 GMT and remained at the high levels in the first few minutes after the announcement.
